summary_brief: 2026年3月12日的AI工具生态系统呈现三大核心趋势：AI代理安全防护成为焦点（Claude Code、Gemini CLI等多项目同步加固），多代理并行协作架构加速落地（Zed、Gemini CLI、DeepAgents等推出子代理调度能力），以及AI编程助手向企业级多云基础设施深度集成。这些变革标志着AI开发工具从单点能力突破转向系统性架构演进。

engineering_signals.title: AI代理安全防护体系全面升级：提示注入防御、工具权限隔离与沙箱标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 随着AI代理在代码执行和PR操作中的权限扩大，安全风险急剧上升。多个主流AI工具同时推出安全加固措施，包括Claude Code的提示注入防御、MCP工具的confirmed参数验证机制、以及Gemini CLI的统一沙箱管理器接口，共同构建AI代理的安全防护网。

engineering_signals.title: 多代理并行协作架构成为主流：子代理调度、A2A通信与客户端-服务器解耦
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AI编程工具正从单一代理向多代理协作架构演进。Zed推出spawn_agent支持并行子代理执行，Gemini CLI实现模型驱动的并行工具调度器，DeepAgents将CLI重构为API服务器的瘦客户端，Gemini CLI新增A2A远程代理认证支持。这一架构转变将显著提升复杂任务的执行效率和上下文管理能力。

engineering_signals.title: AI工具链技术栈大迁移：Python到TypeScript与Python版本升级
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AI开发工具链正在经历重大技术栈转型。Auto-Claude从Python Claude Agent SDK完全迁移到TypeScript Vercel AI SDK v6，代表向类型安全和更好开发体验的转向；同时LlamaIndex正式弃用Python 3.9，推动生态系统向更新Python版本迁移。这些变化将影响大量下游项目的开发决策。

engineering_signals.title: 企业级多云AI基础设施集成：模型覆盖与企业配置增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AI编程助手正在深度集成企业级多云AI基础设施。Claude Code新增modelOverrides支持Bedrock推理配置文件ARN，AutoGPT集成Grok 3、Gemini 3.1、Mistral Large 3等最新模型，Zed集成Vercel AI Gateway，Cline支持Opus 4.6快速模式。这些更新使企业能够灵活选择和统一管理多个云AI提供商。

engineering_signals.title: AI代理记忆与评估体系标准化：MemoryAgentBench与测试覆盖扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AI代理能力评估正在走向标准化。DeepAgents添加ICLR 2026的MemoryAgentBench评估套件专门评估LLM Agent记忆能力，Dify扩展大规模单元测试覆盖核心模块，Claude Code新增/context命令识别内存膨胀。这些工作共同推动AI代理质量和可靠性的提升。

engineering_signals.title: AutoGPT自主代理能力跃升：本地生成、多模态与MCP协议集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: AutoGPT发布重大更新，支持本地代理生成、验证、修复，集成MCP协议和子代理能力，新增@@agptfile文件引用协议，同时支持上传图片和PDF作为多模态视觉块。这些功能大幅提升了自主代理的开发、执行和多模态处理能力，标志着通用AI代理向实用化迈出重要一步。

engineering_signals.title: AI编程助手性能与内存管理优化：异步I/O、代码分割与内存泄漏修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个AI工具推出性能优化措施。AgentScope将会话文件读写异步化减少I/O阻塞，Gemini CLI启用代码分割和延迟加载提升启动性能，Claude Code修复流式API响应缓冲区内存泄漏问题。这些优化显著提升了AI工具在高并发和长时间运行场景下的稳定性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 上下文优化与内存管理
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 /context 命令可识别内存膨胀并提供优化建议，修复了流式 API 响应缓冲区未释放导致的内存泄漏问题，显著提升长时间运行稳定性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 企业级模型配置增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 modelOverrides 设置支持将模型选择器映射到自定义提供商模型 ID（如 Bedrock 推理配置文件 ARN），方便企业集成多云 AI 基础设施。

release_signals.title: AutoGPT 本地代理生成与 MCP 支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持本地代理生成、验证、修复，并集成 MCP 和子代理能力，同时新增 @@agptfile 文件引用协议，大幅提升自主代理的开发和执行能力。

release_signals.title: AutoGPT 多模态与多模型生态扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增支持上传图片和 PDF 作为多模态视觉块，同时扩展支持 Grok 3、Mistral Large 3、Claude Sonnet 4.6 等多款最新模型，生态兼容性大幅提升。

release_signals.title: Zed 编辑器并行子代理架构
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 spawn_agent 工具支持主代理调用子代理并行执行任务，实现更好的上下文管理和任务分发，是 AI 编程工具向多代理协作演进的重要里程碑。

release_signals.title: Zed 集成 Vercel AI Gateway
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Vercel AI Gateway 作为 LLM 提供商，同时支持 GPT-5.3-Codex 模型，扩展了用户对 AI 模型的选择范围和统一网关管理能力。

release_signals.title: Gemini CLI A2A 远程代理认证支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 实现 A2A（Agent-to-Agent）远程代理的 HTTP 认证支持和代理卡片发现机制，为跨平台代理协作奠定安全通信基础。

release_signals.title: Gemini CLI Plan 模式迭代反馈标注
release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持在计划模式下为计划添加反馈标注以进行迭代，同时启用内置研究子代理，提升复杂任务的规划与执行质量。

release_signals.title: Claude Agent SDK 会话管理 API
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 renameSession API 支持重命名会话文件，修复模块解析导出映射问题，提升 SDK 在复杂项目中的可用性。

release_signals.title: Cline 新增 Opus 4.6 快速模式
release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持 Anthropic Opus 4.6 快速模式变体，同时修复 Bedrock 思考块处理和 Gemini Flash 输出令牌限制，提升多平台兼容性。

release_signals.title: LangGraph 远程图 API 上下文支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 为远程图 API 添加上下文支持，同时修复子图重放 bug，增强分布式图执行的可靠性。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added actionable suggestions to `/context` command — identifies context-heavy tools, memory bloat, and capacity warnings with specific optimization tips
- Added `autoMemoryDirectory` setting to configure a custom directory for auto-memory storage
- Fixed memory leak where streaming API response buffers were not released when the generator was terminated early, causing unbounded RSS growth on the Node.js/npm code path
- Fixed managed policy `ask` rules being bypassed by user `allow` rules or skill `allowed-tools`
- Fixed full model IDs (e.g., `claude-opus-4-5`) being silently ignored in agent frontmatter `model:` field and `--agents` JSON config — agents now accept the same model values as `--model`
- Fixed MCP OAuth authentication hanging when the callback port is already in use
- Fixed MCP OAuth refresh never prompting for re-auth after the refresh token expires, for OAuth servers that return errors with HTTP 200 (e.g. Slack)
- Fixed voice mode silently failing on the macOS native binary for users whose terminal had never been granted microphone permission — the binary now includes the `audio-input` entitlement so macOS prompts correctly
- Fixed `SessionEnd` hooks being killed after 1.5 s on exit regardless of `hook.timeout` — now configurable via `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`
- Fixed `/plugin install` failing inside the REPL for marketplace plugins with local sources
- Fixed marketplace update not syncing git submodules — plugin sources in submodules no longer break after update
- Fixed unknown slash commands with arguments silently dropping input — now shows your input as a warning
- Fixed Hebrew, Arabic, and other RTL text not rendering correctly in Windows Terminal, conhost, and VS Code integrated terminal
- Fixed LSP servers not working on Windows due to malformed file URIs
- Changed `--plugin-dir` so local dev copies now override installed marketplace plugins with the same name (unless that plugin is force-enabled by managed settings)
- [VSCode] Fixed delete button not working for Untitled sessions
- [VSCode] Improved scroll wheel responsiveness in the integrated terminal with terminal-aware acceleration

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `modelOverrides` setting to map model picker entries to custom provider model IDs (e.g. Bedrock inference profile ARNs)
- Added actionable guidance when OAuth login or connectivity checks fail due to SSL certificate errors (corporate proxies, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`)
- Fixed freezes and 100% CPU loops triggered by permission prompts for complex bash commands
- Fixed a deadlock that could freeze Claude Code when many skill files changed at once (e.g. during `git pull` in a repo with a large `.claude/skills/` directory)
- Fixed Bash tool output being lost when running multiple Claude Code sessions in the same project directory
- Fixed subagents with `model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` being silently downgraded to older model versions on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry
- Fixed background bash processes spawned by subagents not being cleaned up when the agent exits
- Fixed `/resume` showing the current session in the picker
- Fixed `/ide` crashing with `onInstall is not defined` when auto-installing the extension
- Fixed `/loop` not being available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry and when telemetry was disabled
- Fixed SessionStart hooks firing twice when resuming a session via `--resume` or `--continue`
- Fixed JSON-output hooks injecting no-op system-reminder messages into the model's context on every turn
- Fixed voice mode session corruption when a slow connection overlaps a new recording
- Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start with "ripgrep (rg) not found" on native builds
- Fixed Linux native modules not loading on Amazon Linux 2 and other glibc 2.26 systems
- Fixed "media_type: Field required" API error when receiving images via Remote Control
- Fixed `/heapdump` failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error when the Desktop folder already exists
- Improved Up arrow after interrupting Claude — now restores the interrupted prompt and rewinds the conversation in one step
- Improved IDE detection speed at startup
- Improved clipboard image pasting performance on macOS
- Improved `/effort` to work while Claude is responding, matching `/model` behavior
- Improved voice mode to automatically retry transient connection failures during rapid push-to-talk re-press
- Improved the Remote Control spawn mode selection prompt with better context
- Changed default Opus model on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry to Opus 4.6 (was Opus 4.1)
- Deprecated `/output-style` command — use `/config` instead. Output style is now fixed at session start for better prompt caching
- VSCode: Fixed HTTP 400 errors for users behind proxies or on Bedrock/Vertex with Claude 4.5 models

key_changes: 新增 modelOverrides 设置，支持将模型选择器映射到自定义提供商模型 ID（如 Bedrock 推理配置文件 ARN）
修复权限提示导致的卡顿和 CPU 100% 循环问题，以及大量技能文件变更时的死锁问题
修复子代理在 Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 上被静默降级到旧模型版本的问题
修复 Bash 工具输出丢失、后台进程未清理等多个会话相关问题
改进中断后按上箭头的行为，支持一键恢复中断的提示并回滚对话
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次更新主要修复了多个影响用户体验的严重 bug，包括权限提示导致的卡顿、子代理模型版本降级、会话管理等问题。同时新增了 modelOverrides 设置以支持自定义模型映射，并改进了中断恢复和 IDE 检测等性能体验。

releases.summary:
This week's release includes support for parallel subagents, Vercel AI Gateway as a new LLM provider, git diff stats in the git panel, and support for compound emojis.

We've also migrated all built-in agents to the ACP Registry, enabling you to remove agents you do not use.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added a new `spawn_agent` tool which allows the Zed Agent to utilize subagents for doing tasks in parallel and better context management. ([#50493](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50493))
- Agent: Added support for GPT-5.3-Codex as a bring-your-own-key model in the OpenAI provider. ([#50122](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50122))
- Agent: Added Vercel AI Gateway as a new LLM provider in Zed. ([#50207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50207); thanks [dancer](https://github.com/dancer))
- Agent: Added the ability to jump to a file from a diff inside the agent conversation with option-enter (`editor: Open excerpts`). ([#50292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50292))
- Agent: Added persistence for draft prompts across Zed restarts. ([#49541](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49541))
- Agent: Added persistence for the thinking mode toggle and thinking effort when selecting a thread from history. ([#49714](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49714))
- Agent: Added restoration of token counts and scroll position when loading a previous agent thread. ([#50620](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50620))
- Agent: Improved loading state for the thread view when there's only a running terminal command. ([#50501](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50501))
- Agent: Improved the editing of queued messages by moving the content back to the main message editor, avoiding the chance of it getting sent mid-editing. ([#50490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50490))
- Agent: Made file mention chips in the chat input clickable so they open the referenced files in the editor. ([#46751](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46751); thanks [soyllamas](https://github.com/soyllamas))
- Agent: Added `cmd-y` keybinding for accepting changes in the agent diff review, matching the git diff review shortcut. ([#50656](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50656))
- ACP: Made all built-in agents removable and manageable via the ACP Registry. ([#50094](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50094))
- Added support for providing an API key to OpenAI-compatible edit prediction providers. ([#50615](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50615))

### Git

- Added trusted workspace support for Zed's git integration. ([#50649](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50649))
- Added git diff stats to git panel entries. ([#49519](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49519); thanks [bobbymannino](https://github.com/bobbymannino))

### Languages

- Added support for specifying settings for the Go LSP adapter. ([#50472](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50472))
- Registered `.prettierrc` as a JSON file type. ([#50156](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50156))

### Windows

- Improved auto-update robustness in the face of apps holding the Zed.exe handle. ([#50332](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50332))
- Changed date and time formatting to respect the system time formatting preferences. ([#50227](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50227); thanks [scuzqy](https://github.com/scuzqy))

### Linux

- Reduced GPU memory usage during resize. ([#50030](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50030))

### Other

- macOS: Added `ctrl-enter` keybinding to type a newline in search bars. ([#50420](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50420); thanks [injust](https://github.com/injust))
- Added support for compound emojis. ([#50082](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50082); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Changed the language selector to auto-select the current buffer's language when opened. ([#48475](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48475); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added file icons for YAML, Helm and GitLab files, and used the Docker icon for `Containerfile`. ([#50529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50529); thanks [tzabbi](https://github.com/tzabbi))
- Added support for listing tree-sitter tokens in highlights tree view, including their resolved theme keys. Semantic token entries also show their resolved theme keys. ([#49197](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49197); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Added configurable `vim.yank.background` theme color for vim yank highlight. ([#49517](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49517); thanks [kaspernyhus](https://github.com/kaspernyhus))
- Added truncation for long file names in tab titles. ([#50550](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50550))
- Changed miniprofiler file extension to `.miniprof.json`. ([#50429](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50429))
- Improved redaction of sensitive environment variables from debugger error logs. ([#50008](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50008); thanks [notpeter](https://github.com/notpeter))

## Bug Fixes

- Linux: Handle GPU device loss gracefully. ([#50902](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50902))
- Collab: Fixed unable to rejoin project bug ("already subscribed to entity"). ([#50630](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50630))
- Git: Fixed a bug that caused the git worktree picker from displaying and creating worktrees over collab. ([#50614](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50614))
- Agent: Fixed a UI bug where the agent panel settings would sometimes render the empty state ("No MCP server added yet"), even if there are MCP servers configured in settings.json. In particular, this happened when one of them was hanging on startup. ([#50089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50089))
- Agent: Fixed Agent Panel code blocks not scrolling horizontally during text selection. ([#50416](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50416))
- Fixed `editor::JoinLines` when a multi-line selection includes the end of the final line. ([#48035](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48035); thanks [jrobsonchase](https://github.com/jrobsonchase))
- Fixed a bug where files would still be marked as having git conflicts after resolving them. ([#50327](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50327))
- Fixed a crash on Linux when window callbacks attempted to register new callbacks. ([#49533](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49533); thanks [cardinalpointstudio](https://github.com/cardinalpointstudio))
- Fixed a crash when opening the settings UI. ([#50488](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50488))
- Fixed a crash when rendering mermaid diagrams in markdown preview. ([#50176](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50176))
- Fixed a crash when using "Reveal in File Manager" on files in WSL projects (#46767). ([#50610](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50610); thanks [SarthakMishra](https://github.com/SarthakMishra))
- Fixed an error when OpenRouter returns a usage-only event with empty choices. ([#50603](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50603); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Fixed an issue where class names were not highlighted correctly in JavaScript files. ([#49325](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49325))
- Fixed an issue where the log file and log file backup would keep growing indefinitely. ([#50571](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50571))
- Fixed being able to scroll the edit prediction popover out of the containing pane. ([#50361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50361))
- Fixed a bug in project search where collapsing a single buffer then performing a new search in the same view would break the expand/collapse all button behavior. ([#50525](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50525))
- Fixed cancelled turns in a conversation that failed (e.g. 500 from the LLM provider) being retried even after cancellation. ([#50580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50580))
- Fixed Cmd+click navigating to file instead of definition in certain cases. ([#49012](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49012); thanks [chenwuji2000-cyber](https://github.com/chenwuji2000-cyber))
- Fixed devcontainer git failure toasts so they show the actual git error. ([#49230](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49230); thanks [oliverbarnes](https://github.com/oliverbarnes))
- Fixed extraneous buffer header when splitting the commit view. ([#50606](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50606))
- Fixed GPU acceleration not working on certain Linux devices. ([#50270](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50270))
- Fixed Linux worktree file watching so child entries appear after deleting and recreating a directory at the same path. ([#50412](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50412); thanks [Chriss4123](https://github.com/Chriss4123))
- Fixed multiple mermaid diagram rendering issues in markdown preview. ([#50485](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50485))
- Fixed popover spacing for split diff buttons. ([#49655](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49655))
- Fixed project panel not updating selection when switching to a gitignored file that was already visible. ([#49521](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49521); thanks [skyline69](https://github.com/skyline69))
- Fixed REPL output width clamping to apply to the content area so images don't get clipped by controls. ([#48435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48435); thanks [cvanelteren](https://github.com/cvanelteren))
- Fixed scroll top behavior when there are more sticky headers than vertical_scroll_margin. ([#50359](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50359); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Fixed tab bar not reliably scrolling to the active tab when pinned tabs are present. ([#50538](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50538); thanks [zharinov](https://github.com/zharinov))
- Fixed the "Collapse All Files" button to work globally, now it's limited to the current buffer. ([#50076](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50076); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA))
- Fixed the loading state never terminating after clicking "Add Server" when adding custom MCP servers. There are now timeouts, logs and user-facing errors. ([#50085](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50085))
- Fixed underlines showing in the minimap. ([#48510](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/48510); thanks [amtoaer](https://github.com/amtoaer))
- Fixed Zed failing to initialize OpenGL on certain Linux devices. ([#50646](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50646))
- Fixed Zed panicking on invalid ranges in semantic token deltas. ([#50106](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50106))
- Fixed scrolling when `editor::SplitSelectionIntoLines` is called in long files. ([#49399](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49399); thanks [it-education-md](https://github.com/it-education-md))
- Fixed linked tag renaming breaking when typing `.` in JSX tags like `<Table.Headers>`. ([#50373](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50373); thanks [OmChillure](https://github.com/OmChillure))
- Fixed multiple language servers applying to the same buffer overwriting each other's inlay hints. ([#50377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50377))
- Fixed multiple language servers applying to the same multibuffer discarding each other's inlay hints. ([#50377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50377))
- Fixed a bug that caused some inlay hints to sometimes duplicate. ([#50377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50377))
- Fixed SSH local port forwarding (`-L`) with IPv6 addresses. ([#49032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49032); thanks [chenwuji2000-cyber](https://github.com/chenwuji2000-cyber))
- Fixed a crash that could occur on macOS when changing monitor configurations. ([#50878](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50878))
- Fixed the `Expand All Files`/`Collapse All Files` button in the project diff view. ([#50859](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50859))
- Fixed a panic in `lsp_symbols_at_cursor` when dealing with diff hunks. ([#51077](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51077))
- Fixed a source of underflowing subtractions causing spurious panics. ([#51078](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51078))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Removed unused `file_finder.git_status` setting. ([#49889](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/49889))
- Removed the stack trace multibuffer view. ([#50144](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50144))

key_changes: 新增并行子代理（subagents）支持，允许 Zed Agent 并行处理任务并优化上下文管理
集成 Vercel AI Gateway 作为新的 LLM 提供商
支持 GPT-5.3-Codex 模型（自带 API Key 模式）
内置代理迁移至 ACP Registry，用户可移除不需要的代理
Git 面板新增 diff 统计信息，支持复合 emoji 表情符号
ai_summary.summary_cn: Zed v0.227.1 版本带来多项重要的 AI 功能增强，包括支持并行子代理以提升任务处理效率，以及集成 Vercel AI Gateway 作为新的 LLM 提供商。此外，所有内置代理已迁移至 ACP Registry，让用户可以灵活管理代理配置。Git 面板也增加了 diff 统计功能，并完善了对复合 emoji 的支持。

changes.description: 废弃 /output-style 命令，需改用 /config 命令；输出样式现在在会话开始时固定以优化提示缓存
Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry 平台的默认 Opus 模型从 4.1 升级到 4.6，可能影响现有工作流
Markdown 图片加载现在需要用户明确授权同意
移除未使用的 file_finder.git_status 配置项
移除堆栈跟踪多缓冲区视图（stack trace multibuffer view）功能

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次分析覆盖2个仓库，其中aider检测到5个有效Issue信号，最严重的是LiteLLM依赖版本不同步导致启动崩溃（P1，5个独立用户报告，置信度0.95）。gptme仓库未发现显著Issue信号。
global_highlights: 【P1阻断】LiteLLM上游变更引发aider启动时ImportError/UnicodeDecodeError崩溃，虽已修复但高频出现，暴露AI工具链对LLM SDK依赖的脆弱性（#4907/#4906/#4904）
【依赖治理】aider集中爆发3起依赖相关问题（LiteLLM、Playwright、PostHog），反映出可选依赖未正确声明、上游API签名变更未及时适配等供应链风险管理不足
【功能缺陷】自定义YAML Tree-sitter查询配置后repo map仍为空（#4558），Issue长期开放且近期活跃，说明文档化功能存在持续性问题

top_pain_points.summary: 5个独立用户报告启动时崩溃，直接阻断主流程。问题源于LiteLLM上游变更导致aider无法导入，属于依赖同步问题。虽已修复但高频出现，是真实用户痛点
